messages:
Asha - Marketing: Heads-up — benchmark report + launch next Tue. Need a clear asset matrix for design. Quick list: social hero, one-slide benchmark visual, comparison diagram (ours vs cloud vendors), and a one-pager PDF. Who can take what? :rocket:
Priya - Content: I can draft the blurb and methodology paragraph. Will need the diagram copy + legend. ETA: Thur morning.
Tom - Growth: +1 on diagram — also need a short CTA variant for paid social (20–30 chars) and a HubSpot form integration; form id is 1234. Can we include a field 'current inference cost per 1M tokens' for MQL routing?
Ella - Design: I can take hero + slide. Need sizes + source files and the raw numbers/CSV for charts. Preference: Figma components and an editable Illustrator SVG for the comparison diagram.
Asha - Marketing: thanks. Specs: social hero 1200x630 (PNG + SVG), slide 1920x1080 (Figma + PPT export), comparison diagram vector SVG + high-res PNG, one-pager A4 PDF (CMYK, 300dpi). Brand tokens: use --brand-blue (#0B5FFF), --accent-green (#00C48C), use Inter var for headers.
DesignBot: Brand tokens v2.3 confirmed — updated logo lockups and token RGB/hex in the brand kit: https://redwood/brand/kit (note: use updated small-logo for <600px).
Ella - Design: copying specs. Quick q: do we call out absolute numbers or relative percentages in the diagram? Relative is cleaner but marketing wants an absolute table too.
Priya - Content: include both — top-line callout for press + absolute table in the appendix one-pager. I'll prepare a short methodology note: sample size, models tested, batch sizes, quantization levels.
Tom - Growth: Routing rules: if a lead reports baseline cost > $2000/mo or selects 'enterprise' in form, route to Sales AE queue; otherwise Marketing SDR. Also capture 'use-case' tag (safety, search, assistant).
Sam - Legal: quick flag — any claim like "40% cheaper" or "guaranteed latency" needs a source footnote. Send me the benchmark methodology draft and raw CSV and we'll stamp it.
Asha - Marketing: deadline: first drafts by Friday EOD; final assets by Monday noon so we can load into HubSpot and webinar slides. Ella, assign yourself hero + slide. Priya you own the one-pager content + methodology. Tom you confirm HubSpot fields & CTA text. Sam will do legal review.
Ella - Design: assigned. I'll push a Figma file tonight: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/benchmark-launch — will add components and a working chart using the CSV.
Priya - Content: uploading data and copy snippets to the figma file comment thread. CSV link: https://s3.redwood/benchmarks/launch-data.csv.
Tom - Growth: CTA variants: "Reduce inference cost" (26), "Faster LLM inference" (19), "Cut model cost 2x" (16) — prefer 1st two. I'll wire up the HubSpot form id and map the fields.
Sam - Legal: requested the methodology doc and the raw CSV. I can turn around review in 24 hours after I get them.
Asha - Marketing: nit: brand compliance — make sure the comparison diagram uses neutral labeling (Vendor A/B) not competitor names. Also final assets need accessibility alt text.
Ella - Design: noted on neutral labels + alt text. Will add accessible color-contrast check and export alt-text strings in the assets folder.
Asha - Marketing: awesome. Follow-ups: 1) @Ella — can you post exported JPEG/PNG proofs to #marketing-review by Fri 10am? 2) @Tom — confirm HubSpot field mapping by Fri noon. 3) @Sam — legal check by Mon 10am.
Ella - Design: yes to Friday 10am.
Tom - Growth: will confirm mapping by Fri noon.
Sam - Legal: will review Monday AM.
Asha - Marketing: perfect. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :raised_hands:
